dossier_meta.paper: On symmetric intersecting families of vectors
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Polynomial improvement on symmetric intersecting family size bound
dossier_meta.statement_text: Show that there exist constants $c, \delta > 0$ (possibly depending on $k$) such that for any symmetric intersecting $A \subset [k]^n$, we have $\log_k |A| \leq n - cn^{\delta}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is posed in Section 4 as a concrete and more modest goal, falling short of identifying the exact extremal size: even a polynomial gain over the $o(k^n)$ bound of Theorem 1.1, expressed as $\log_k |A| \leq n - cn^\delta$, would be a significant advance.
